get.description: Keyset feed of the public boards for sitemaps, the same for every caller: it lists exactly what an anonymous reader can open, whatever bearer the request carries. Each page examines at most 4 × `limit` candidate rows, so it may return fewer than `limit` items, even none, with a non-null `next`. Follow `next` until it is `null`. `lastModified` is the last significant change of what the page shows; a post edit or removal does not advance it.
